title: Half a million modules
text: A utility-scale solar project ships half a million modules. [beat] Meet Ree Doms, a Wayam AI product.

title: One workspace per project
text: One workspace per project. Every module is accounted for. The flash data, the inspections, and the paper trail behind each one.

title: The record lives in spreadsheets
text: Today, that record lives in spreadsheets. Flash data in one file, inspection reports in another, serial numbers on paper at the gate. When a module underperforms three years in, [beat] nobody can prove where it came from.

title: One chain of custody
text: Ree Doms closes that gap with one chain of custody. The supplier uploads. Every lot is verified. The shop floor is inspected. Modules ship, get scanned into position, and reconcile against the plan.

title: Any serial, its whole history
text: Type any module serial number, and the whole history comes back. Flash test values, junction box, bin, pallet, and the electroluminescence image taken on the line. One search. [beat] Full provenance.

title: Every lot, checked against the file
text: Pre-dispatch inspection runs against the supplier's own file. Ree Doms reads every lot offered, eighteen thousand modules at a time, and flags any serial number that does not match what was actually built.

title: The shop floor, on the record
text: Inspections are structured, not freeform. Date, supplier, shift, then every stage of the line recorded against its specification, with non-conformance captured where it happens.

title: Which module, in which row
text: At site, the supervisor scans each panel into its table position. Row by row, the as-built map fills in.

title: One number set, live
text: Management sees the whole project as one live set of numbers. Planned against verified, in a single view.

title: Every module has a record
text: From the factory line, to the row it stands in. Every module carries a record. One search brings the whole of it back. That is Ree Doms. [beat] A Wayam AI product.
